evidence_class: Manufacturer-authored chip data brief hosted by distributor; not exact Garmin board schematic

contracts.chip_fact: VUSB is a 3.3V USB pad supply
contracts.inference: Chip VUSB or a diagnostic 3.3V ID reading does not establish a 5V USB host power-output circuit. Exact pin meaning and board power path remain unknown.

contracts.chip_fact: USB D+ and D- pins support UART transmit/receive muxing
contracts.inference: A routed connector needs verified active pin mux and USB driver role, not merely a matching connector or chip OTG feature.
The tested RGB565 software surface is not proof of real framebuffer address, stride, cache policy or presentation ownership.

contracts.chip_fact: Data brief explicitly documents Baseline DCT JPEG hardware decoding
contracts.inference: The selected brief provides no H264 acceleration evidence; this does not prove no hardware decoder exists. Do not use the 3D/JPEG listing to waive an actual H264 throughput measurement.
